annotations.title: US tax for Americans living in the Netherlands (FEIE vs Foreign Tax Credit)

description: For a US citizen or green-card holder with a Dutch salary: Dutch tax, the creditable part (AOW/Anw premiums are not creditable under the US-Dutch totalization agreement), and the US tax for 2026 under the Foreign Earned Income Exclusion and under the Foreign Tax Credit, incl. the child tax credit and its refundable part.

children.description: Qualifying children under 17 with an SSN. Default 0.

gross_annual_eur.description: Dutch gross annual salary in euros, without holiday allowance

other_us_income_usd.description: Other US-taxed income, e.g. US dividends, in dollars. Default 0.

thirty_percent_ruling.description: Has the Dutch 30% ruling. Default false.

usd_per_eur.description: Exchange rate, dollars per euro. Default 1.13.
